title: Chart, version 1
description: A chart as data (lib/specs.py: to_json, from_json): one or more panels on a shared time axis, top to bottom. Times are ISO local times with their UTC offset; dates are ISO dates.

version.description: This schema's version: a change that would misread an older chart gets a new one.

title.description: What is drawn: the panels' names.

subtitle.description: The period, how the lines were drawn ("30-minute readings", "daily averages"), what a bar covers and whether a range is shaded.

period.description: The first and last day the chart covers, or null when it doesn't say.

source.description: Where the data came from ("Ecowitt weather station"), written small in the corner; "" for none.

drawn_by.description: The call that drew this chart, to draw it again: the same tool with these arguments, `period` swapped for one of `periods` to draw it over another stretch. Absent on a chart no tool call drew.

arguments.description: Every argument the call was given, filled in: readings fully named, the period in words.

periods.description: The periods it can be redrawn over, in order; [] when it can't be (a chart over set times).

label.description: What to call it on a button ("7 days").

newest.description: The time of the newest reading drawn: a line's last point or the start of the last bar.

time.description: A local time with its UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-04T03:30:00+11:00.

panel.description: One panel: lines (each a line or a band) with rain-style bars behind them on a scale of their own, or bars alone, or a rating alone.

unit.description: The unit of the lines' axis ("" when each line carries its own, on two axes).

reading.description: Which reading the panel is ("humidity", "pm2_5" ...), for its colours; "" for a mix.

flip_right.description: The right-hand axis runs top to bottom (a line on it falls as its reading rises).

peaks.description: How the highs and lows are labelled: on the lines, beside them, or not at all.

zones.description: A rated reading's limits: good up to the first, poor up to the second, very poor above.

line.description: A line of readings: points [time, value].

records.description: The true lowest and highest readings, with when: the labels on the line.

reading.description: Which reading the line is, for its colour; "" for its panel's.

smoothed.description: The line is a light average of the readings, not the readings.

indoor.description: The indoor sensor's line (drawn in its reading's complementary colour).

right.description: Read against the panel's right-hand axis.

on_line.description: Its peak is marked on the line itself, not on the top of its band.

band.description: A line with the range each point stands for shaded around it: points [time, value, low, high].

bars.description: Bars (rain, or a count or figure per month or year): points [the bar's start, value].

per.description: What a bar covers, in words: "hour", "6 hours", "day", "month", "year"; "" when not said.

values.description: Each bar's number is written above it.

rating.description: The share of each bar's time in each rating: points [the bar's start, good, poor, very poor] (percent).

compass.description: A wind rose of the whole period, beside a chart of one panel of lines.

rose.description: For each of the 16 compass points, N first and clockwise: the readings in each speed step (light, middle, strong).

speeds.description: The readings carried a wind speed, so the steps mean something.

speed_steps.description: Where the middle and strong steps begin (km/h).
